component.name: Progress
component.description: Determinate or indeterminate progress indicator with optional step labels.

slots.name: root
slots.description: Progress container that owns track, indicator, labels, and step markers.

ariaAttributes.name: aria-valuemax
ariaAttributes.description: Defines the maximum value for range-like controls.

ariaAttributes.name: aria-valuemin
ariaAttributes.description: Defines the minimum value for range-like controls.

ariaAttributes.name: aria-valuenow
ariaAttributes.description: Defines the current numeric value for range-like controls.

ariaAttributes.name: aria-valuetext
ariaAttributes.description: Provides human-readable text for the current value.

ariaAttributes.name: role
ariaAttributes.description: Defines the semantic role exposed to assistive technology.

slots.name: status
slots.description: Text region that displays the current progress status.

slots.name: track
slots.description: Background rail that represents the full progress range.

slots.name: indicator
slots.description: Filled bar that represents the current progress value.

slots.name: steps
slots.description: Wrapper for step labels when progress is driven by named steps.

slots.name: step
slots.description: Individual step label or marker rendered along the progress scale.

own.name: class
own.description: Class applied to the component root or trigger element.

own.name: getValueLabel
own.type: ((params: { value: number; min: number; max: number; }) => string) | undefined
own.description: Callback to get a localized label for the current value.

own.name: max
own.description: The maximum value of the progress bar, or an array of step labels.

own.name: ref
own.type: JSX.HTMLElementTags["div"] extends { ref?: infer Ref; } ? Ref : never | undefined

own.name: status
own.description: Whether to show the status label.

own.name: statusRender
own.description: Custom render function for the status label.

own.name: stepRender
own.description: Custom render function for each step when `max` is an array.

own.name: value
own.description: The current value of the progress bar. If null/undefined, it is indeterminate.
